sql:
WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderid,
    (COALESCE(o.comments, '') ILIKE '%promo%' OR COALESCE(o.internalcomments, '') ILIKE '%promo%' OR COALESCE(o.deliveryinstructions, '') ILIKE '%promo%') AS has_promotion,
    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '2024-11-29' AND o.orderdate < DATE '2024-11-30'
  GROUP BY o.orderid, (COALESCE(o.comments, '') ILIKE '%promo%' OR COALESCE(o.internalcomments, '') ILIKE '%promo%' OR COALESCE(o.deliveryinstructions, '') ILIKE '%promo%')
),
groups AS (
  SELECT TRUE AS has_promotion, 'With promotion' AS promotion_group
  UNION ALL
  SELECT FALSE AS has_promotion, 'Without promotion' AS promotion_group
)
SELECT
  g.promotion_group,
  AVG(v.order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM groups g
LEFT JOIN order_values v ON v.has_promotion = g.has_promotion
GROUP BY g.promotion_group, g.has_promotion
ORDER BY g.has_promotion DESC

LIMIT 501
